issue_context.title: more information in the analyze status
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Currently, when executing the "show analyze status" command, it does not display the progress of ongoing analysis tasks. This lack of information makes it difficult to track the status and estimate the completion time of the analysis process.

### Proposal:
I suggest enhancing the "show analyze status" command to provide more detailed information, including the progress of each analysis task. This information could include the percentage of completion, the number of analyzed rows, and any relevant statistics. By displaying this additional information, users will have better visibility into the progress and status of ongoing analysis tasks.

### Expected Benefits

Improved monitoring and tracking: The enhanced "show analyze status" command will allow users to monitor and track the progress of analysis tasks in real-time, enabling better management and planning.
Better estimation of completion time: With the inclusion of progress information, users can estimate the remaining time required for completion, facilitating better resource allocation and scheduling.
